findings.reason: the precedent is in this same plan — a prior review raised exactly this on §20 (a code change plus a backfill under one gate) and the plan acted by splitting it; §31 repeats the shape at three-way scale.
findings.text: §31 bundles three disjoint deliverables under one gate: 183 signed retirement records, 25 stage restorations, and 14 successor edges, each through its own signed authority ("one authority per class", line 221), yet the section carries one data-status="implementable" and one done-when, so no single verdict can close it — a node that lands the 183 and fails the 14 cannot be reviewed on one measure, and the gate proves none of the three

findings.reason: without a named durable path a later reader cannot open the retirement records, the restored stages or the edges-with-receipts that the section's only measure rests on; a prior review raised the same "names no path" finding on §27 and it was acted on.
findings.text: §31's done-when requires "a logged read ending EXIT=0" for each count and relies on three signed authorities and their receipts, but names no path for the logged reads, for the authorities, or for the receipts, unlike §21's done-when which places its manifest and receipt under docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/

findings.reason: the two sibling sections each closed this exact hole with a stated control, and §31 — the section whose whole value is a zero — omits it, so its pass condition can be met by a broken query.
findings.text: §31's first done-when bullet asserts "0 superseded names with neither a successor relation nor a recorded supersession event", a zero with no control that the instrument can see the population it is draining: §30's done-when required the instrument to "prove it can see the population as well as the gap" and §19's required a split summing to an independently counted total, but §31's re-run carries no such control, so a query blind to HAS_SUCCESSOR or to the supersession event returns 0 and reads as "all clear"

findings.reason: a node given §31 cannot tell which 208 names fall into the 183 versus the 25, or which 9 carry superseded_from_stage, from any committed source, so it must re-derive the buckets before it can act, and where it re-derives differs from the remedy the cited census fragment records.
findings.text: §31 states "The §30 census found 208 superseded names with no recorded supersession. On 2026-10-14 the lead ruled to record 183, restore 25 and link 14", with "171 of them carry paid reviews", but the cited §30 census fragment (docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-superseded-lineage-census.html) holds no producing-source split and no 183/25/171 figure (grep for 183 or 171 there returns nothing); it classifies all 517 by supersession mechanism only, and its remedy column for the 96 maintenance-only and 112 no-change classes reads "a reclassification out of superseded — no supersession event exists to justify the stage", the opposite of the keep-at-superseded-and-stamp instruction §31 carries

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — imas_codex/discovery/AGENTS.md resolves (the file exists), and "as §30's review asked" resolves to the §30 review comment (line 599); extensionless hrefs elsewhere resolve as <path>.html per house convention.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §31's first done-when bullet is a bare zero with no declared control that the census can see the population it is emptying (line 221), the failure §19 and §30 were each explicitly hardened against.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: a finding — §31 requires logged reads, three signed authorities and their receipts, and names no durable path for any of them (line 221).
rubric_items.naming: pass — §31's heading and symbols carry quantities (183, 25, 14), not plan labels, stage names or ticket numbers; no changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §31 attributes to the §30 census a producing-source partition (183 / 25) and a paid-review count (171) that the cited census fragment does not contain, and whose stated remedy for those classes is the opposite instruction (line 221 vs the census class table).
rubric_items.single_goal: a finding — §31 carries three deliverables (record 183, restore 25, link 14) under one section, one status and one gate (lines 219-221).
rubric_items.wiring: pass — no section declares a depends-on/informs/gates link (every data-links is empty), so no declared relationship points at the wrong node; §31's reliance on §30 is carried in prose and §30 is done.
